[project]
name = "inventory"
version = "1.0.0"

[tool.ruff]
exclude = ["*"]
[tool.ruff.lint]
ignore = ["ALL"]

[tool.mypy]
ignore_errors = true

[tool.pylint."messages control"]
disable = ["all"]

[tool.bandit]
skips = ["B105", "B201", "B301", "B307", "B324", "B403", "B404", "B506", "B602", "B608"]

[tool.vulture]
min_confidence = 100

[tool.codespell]
ignore-words-list = "recieve,seperate"
skip = "*"
